title: Social Chat
description: Where to read live comments from, and how they go on air. Keys and tokens are stored sealed and never shown back.

youtube_video.title: YouTube stream
youtube_video.description: The live stream's address (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...), its 11 character id, or the channel's @handle. A stream address costs 1 quota unit to look up; a channel costs 100. Leave empty with OAuth to find your own live stream.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube API key
youtube_api_key.description: An API key from a Google Cloud project with the YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Stored sealed; never shown back.

youtube_oauth_token.title: YouTube OAuth access token
youtube_oauth_token.description: Optional. An OAuth access token with the youtube.readonly scope, for a private or unlisted stream, or to find your own live stream. It expires in an hour unless the three refresh fields are set too.

youtube_client_id.title: YouTube OAuth client id
youtube_client_id.description: Optional. With the client secret and the refresh token, lets the plugin renew the OAuth token itself.

youtube_refresh_token.title: YouTube OAuth refresh token
youtube_refresh_token.description: Optional. A refresh token for the client above.

youtube_min_poll_seconds.title: YouTube slowest poll
youtube_min_poll_seconds.description: Never read the YouTube chat more often than this, whatever YouTube suggests. Each read costs 5 quota units out of 10,000 a day, so 5 seconds lasts about 2.8 hours of chat and 10 seconds about 5.5.

twitch_channels.title: Twitch channels
twitch_channels.description: One or more Twitch channel names, separated by commas. Read anonymously; no account or key is needed.

facebook_live_video.title: Facebook live video
facebook_live_video.description: The live video's address or number. Leave empty to use whatever the Page is streaming now.

facebook_page_token.title: Facebook Page access token
facebook_page_token.description: A Page access token for the Page that is live, with pages_read_engagement and pages_read_user_content. Stored sealed; never shown back.

facebook_mode.title: Facebook connection
facebook_mode.description: stream holds one connection open and Facebook pushes comments; poll asks every few seconds. stream falls back to poll by itself when Facebook refuses it.

webhook_enabled.title: Accept comments by webhook
webhook_enabled.description: Listen for comments POSTed as JSON by another tool or platform.

webhook_bind.title: Webhook address
webhook_bind.description: The address the webhook listens on. 127.0.0.1 takes posts from this machine only; 0.0.0.0 from the network, so set a secret.

webhook_port.title: Webhook port
webhook_port.description: The port the webhook listens on.

webhook_secret.title: Webhook secret
webhook_secret.description: Optional. When set, a post must carry it in the X-Social-Chat-Secret header or as a Bearer token.

x_enabled.title: X (Twitter)
x_enabled.description: X's API is paid; this adapter is a stub that says so. Send X replies in through the webhook instead.

practice_mode.title: Practice mode
practice_mode.description: Send made up comments every few seconds, to rehearse with the panel and the on air card.

keep.title: Comments kept
keep.description: How many comments the list holds before the oldest go.

question_colour.title: Question colour
question_colour.description: The colour that marks a comment asking a question.

card_style.title: On air style
card_style.description: card is a box with the picture, the name and up to three lines; strap is a one line lower third.
